title: Erin's Challenge! Episode 1 — はじめまして
description: In Episode 1 of Erin's Challenge!, high-school exchange student Erin arrives in Japan and navigates her first day — greetings at school, self-introduction, and joining a club. Core N5 expressions: はじめまして、よろしくお願いします、～です、～じゃないです。
